project.title: Microbial community in washing machine biofilm sample
project.description: Current understanding of washing machine biofilms remains limited in terms of their structural characteristics and microbial diversity. The objective of this study was to investigate microbial biofilms formed on front-load and top-load washing machines. We disassembled 12 washing machines and collected a total of 180 biofilms from six different components including the drain bellows, gasket, pulsator, drum, tub, and detergent drawer.
